description: List configured IDs/names without network by default. Optional bounded read-only probes; no discovery or writes.
name: wled_list_devices

description: Read normalized state, raw state and essential firmware/capability facts of one configured device. Always fresh, never cached; state and info are read one after the other, not as an atomic snapshot. Read-only.
name: wled_get_state

description: Read the effect catalog with original device IDs and names, optional raw fxdata metadata and freshness. Cached per device for a configured time; refresh=true bypasses the cache. Read-only.
name: wled_get_effects

description: Read the palette catalog with original device IDs and names and freshness. Cached per device for a configured time; refresh=true bypasses the cache. Read-only.
name: wled_get_palettes

description: Apply a typed master patch: optional on/brightness/transition_ms. Omitted fields remain unchanged. Transition is a one-call tt (ms) that does not touch persistent 'transition'. dry_run performs bounded reads only and returns the resolved plan.

inputSchema.description:
Master patch. At least one of ``on`` / ``brightness`` must be present.

Transition is a one-call ``tt`` value in milliseconds. Persistent
``transition`` is never touched.
inputSchema.title: SetStateRequest

name: wled_set_state

description: Patch one or more existing active segments by explicit ID. Omitted fields and unrelated segments are preserved. No segment creation or removal. dry_run performs bounded reads only and returns the plan.

SegmentPatch.description:
One explicit segment patch. At least one mutable field must be set.

``start`` and ``stop`` must be supplied together when either is present.
SegmentPatch.title: SegmentPatch

inputSchema.description: Nonempty list of segment patches. Omitted segments are untouched.
inputSchema.title: PatchSegmentsRequest

name: wled_patch_segments

description: Replace the complete active segment layout. Every desired ID needs id, start and stop; active IDs not listed are removed one by one (exact single-segment removal, no filler segments, no bulk purge). Omitted fields of existing IDs are preserved; new IDs need colors and receive documented defaults. Master state is never changed. Each step is read back; an uncertain or mismatching step stops the sequence without replay. dry_run performs bounded reads only and returns the ordered plan.

LayoutSegment.description: One segment of the complete desired layout (id, start and stop are required).
LayoutSegment.title: LayoutSegment

inputSchema.description: The complete desired active layout. Active IDs not listed here are removed.
inputSchema.title: ReplaceLayoutRequest

name: wled_replace_layout

description: List the persistent presets (IDs 1-250) of one configured device with ID, name and type (state, playlist, api-command or unknown). Empty slots and reserved IDs are omitted. Always read fresh from the device, never cached. Read-only.
name: wled_list_presets

description: Read one stored preset exactly as the device holds it, with its type. The object may contain stored commands; it is returned to the caller unchanged. PRESET_NOT_FOUND for an empty slot. Always fresh. Read-only.
name: wled_get_preset

description: Activate an existing state preset or a playlist made only of state presets. Changes the live output and may interrupt current playback; never writes storage. API-command and unknown entries are refused. Verified by bounded state readback. dry_run performs bounded reads only.
name: wled_activate_preset

description: Save the CURRENT live state under a name (at most 32 UTF-8 bytes) into the lowest free persistent ID, or into an explicit preset_id. Replacing an occupied ID needs overwrite=true and takes a durable snapshot first; playlists are never replaced. Sends storage controls only (no state fields), so nothing is applied or activated, but firmware side effects of saving are not verified. Outcome is decided by bounded /presets.json polling; an uncertain outcome is never replayed. No supplied-state input exists. dry_run performs bounded reads only.

inputSchema.description: Save the current live state; there is deliberately no supplied-state input.
inputSchema.title: SavePresetRequest

name: wled_save_preset

description: Delete exactly one stored preset (any type) after a durable snapshot. Referencing playlists and the active-preset marker are not edited; a warning names them. Outcome is decided by bounded /presets.json polling for absence; an uncertain outcome is never replayed. dry_run performs bounded reads only.
name: wled_delete_preset
